vedic_reference.note: In Hinduism, Sandhya is the time of day between sunset and the onset of night. It is considered an auspicious time for prayer and rituals, and is also a time for transition and change. In the Vedas, Sandhya is described as the time when the sun is 'stolen' from the demons by the gods, and is a time of balance and harmony.
